narratives.Description: After #3529, versioned interpreters and dest-form writers still classify empty under UAT and allow write-shaped Shell into .deft/authz, kill-switch files, and .deft/approved-scope. This story extends classify.ts dest parsing and fail-closes unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under UAT without false-denying ordinary /tmp dests.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

AppSec scan on **`0b212e25`** (post-**#3529**) found two **HIGH** UAT Shell classification residuals and one **MEDIUM** incomplete mint-path fix.

Under active UAT, further write-capable binaries still classify empty / unclassifiable and **allow** write-shaped Shell. That path can plant a forged `.deft/authz` grant or a regular-file `.deft-directive-disable` kill-switch. Separately, residual Shell writers can still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied, so the #3410 / #3421 / #3529 mint gate is incomplete.

These residuals use dest forms that **#3529's harvest does not cover** (`ruby3.3` / `jruby` / `pypy3` versioned interpreters, Perl `File::Slurp` / `spew` / `open F,">"`, `make DESTDIR=`, `dpkg -x`, `fromdos` / `todos`, `emacsclient` / `pico`, `pdftk` / `gs`, `npx degit`, `composer`, `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `sg_dd`, `darcs --repodir=`).

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `0b212e25`
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT** with PreToolUse Shell hooks

**Already denied after #3529 (do not re-report):** `xcopy` / `robocopy` / `move` / `bun` / `deno` / `php` / BitsTransfer / Expand-Archive / `cmd /c copy` / `ginstall` / `tsx` / `cp`. Contrast: those peers remain settings-denied. Bare `ruby` / `python3` / `dpkg-deb` also deny; **versioned** `ruby3.3` / `jruby` / `pypy3` do not.

**Not duplicates of prior review findings -14 / -15 / -17.** These three are new validated residuals after the #3529 close.

---

## Findings

### 1. HIGH — UAT residual after #3529: versioned interpreters / dest-form writers still plant `.deft/authz` grants

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT with PreToolUse Shell hooks |
| **Input** | Residual writers whose dest is **not** covered by the #3529 harvest: `ruby3.3` / `jruby` / `pypy3`; Perl `File::Slurp` / `spew` / `open F,">"`; `make DESTDIR=.deft/authz/grants`; `dpkg -x`; `fromdos` / `todos`; `emacsclient` / `pico`; `pdftk` / `gs`; `npx degit`; `composer`; `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `sg_dd`; `darcs --repodir=` targeting `.deft/authz/grants/*.json` |
| **Path** | Residual bins classify `[]` → `shell-op-unclassifiable` **allow** → forged grant JSON → empty `activeGrantIds` activates human-origin grants → Write / push / PR / merge unlock |
| **Impact** | Complete residual bypass of Wave 1 UAT human-approval after #3529 |
| **Fix** | Extend `isProgrammaticWriteBinToken` for `rubyN` / `jruby` / `pypy`. Treat `write_file` / `spew` as write APIs. Classify `DESTDIR` / `dpkg -x` / `fromdos` / `emacsclient` / `pico` / `pdftk` / `gs` / `degit` / `composer` / `ddrescue` family dests. Under UAT, **fail-closed** on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell. Do **not** stop at named-peer allowlists. Bare `ruby` / `python3` / `dpkg-deb` / `xcopy` already deny. |

### 2. HIGH — UAT residual after #3529: same writer class still plants `.deft-directive-disable`

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same residual class targeting `.deft-directive-disable` as a regular file. Verified: `ruby3.3` / `pypy3` / `jruby` / `fromdos` / `emacsclient` / `pico` / `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `npx degit`. Contrast: bare Perl kill forms remain settings-denied. |
| **Path** | classify `[]` → Shell **allow** → plant kill-switch → subsequent tools `allow` / `directive-disabled` (`detectDeftDirectiveDisable.active`, #3039) |
| **Impact** | Immediate complete Directive gate bypass for the rest of the session |
| **Fix** | Same classify extensions for kill-switch basenames. Mirror the authz fail-closed posture from finding (1). |

### 3. MEDIUM — Incomplete #3529: residual Shell writers still forge `.deft/approved-scope` while Write is denied

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Residual dest writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/**` after Write is denied for the same path (Write denied; residual writers above still allow; contrast `cp` denied) |
| **Path** | Write denies the mint artifact; residual Shell classify misses the dest form → **allow** → forged provenance approval without `#3110` human-presence mint |
| **Impact** | Bypasses #3410 / #3421 / #3529 mint gate via Write / Shell asymmetry |
| **Fix** | Extend approved-scope Shell classify to the same residual dest writers as findings (1) and (2). |

---

## Evidence

Live probe on **`0b212e25`** (`classifyShellAuthzOps` + `decideHook` Bash PreToolUse, active UAT, empty grants):

| Command class | classify | decideHook |
|---------------|----------|------------|
| `ruby3.3` / `jruby` / `pypy3` write into `.deft/authz/grants` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| Perl `File::Slurp` / `spew` / `open F,">"` into authz dest | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `make DESTDIR=.deft/authz/grants` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `dpkg -x` targeting authz dest | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `fromdos` / `todos` targeting authz dest | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `emacsclient` / `pico` targeting authz dest | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `pdftk` / `gs` targeting authz dest | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `npx degit` / `composer` targeting authz dest | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `sg_dd` targeting authz dest | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| `darcs --repodir=` targeting authz dest | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| Same residual writers targeting `.deft-directive-disable` (verified `ruby3.3` / `pypy3` / `jruby` / `fromdos` / `emacsclient` / `pico` / `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `npx degit`) | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| Same residual writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope` | `[]` | **allow** / `shell-op-unclassifiable` |
| Write to `.deft/approved-scope` | settings | **deny** |
| Bare `ruby` / `python3` / `dpkg-deb` / `xcopy` (authz dest) | settings | **deny** |
| Bare Perl kill-switch forms | settings | **deny** |
| `cp` targeting `.deft/approved-scope` | settings | **deny** |

Ordinary dests such as `/tmp` stay unclassifiable (do not overclassify).

## Not re-reported

- `xcopy` / `robocopy` / `move` / `bun` / `deno` / `php` / BitsTransfer / Expand-Archive — #3529 fixed
- `ginstall` / `gcp` / `cmd copy` / `tsx` / `cp` — #3459 / #3421 / #3529 fixed
- Bare `ruby` / `python3` / `dpkg-deb` — already settings-denied (versioned `ruby3.3` / `jruby` / `pypy3` are the hole)
- Bare Perl kill-switch forms — already settings-denied
- Prior review findings **-14 / -15 / -17** — not these residuals; do not close this as a duplicate of those

## Acceptance criteria

**HIGH — UAT Shell residuals (must land together)**

- [ ] Under active UAT, listed residual binaries that write into `.deft/authz/**` classify as **settings deny** (not unclassifiable allow)
- [ ] Same bins targeting `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as **settings deny**
- [ ] Dest parsing covers `rubyN` / `jruby` / `pypy`, Perl `write_file` / `spew` / `open F,">"`, `make DESTDIR=`, `dpkg -x`, `fromdos` / `todos`, `emacsclient` / `pico`, `pdftk` / `gs`, `npx degit`, `composer`, `ddrescue` / `dc3dd` / `sg_dd`, `darcs --repodir=` when dest is protected
- [ ] Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable **write-shaped** Shell under UAT (not silent allow). Do not stop at named-peer allowlists.
- [ ] Regression tests cover residual bins vs already-denied peers (bare `ruby` / `python3` / `dpkg-deb` / `xcopy` / `cp`)
- [ ] No false deny of ordinary non-authz / non-kill-switch dests (e.g. `/tmp`) outside UAT write paths

**MEDIUM — approved-scope mint symmetry**

- [ ] Under active UAT, residual Shell writers targeting `.deft/approved-scope/**` classify as **settings deny**, matching Write
- [ ] Forged Shell mint cannot satisfy provenance approval without the shared #3110 human-presence mint

**Release hygiene**

- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` security note (brief; no exploit cookbook)

## Related

- Residual of #3529 UAT Shell dest-form hardening (closed; this scan is post-fix on `0b212e25`)
- Residual of #3459 / #3421 UAT Shell dest-form hardening
- #3410 mint (`scope:record-approved-scope` / shared #3110 gate); parent epic #3376
- Kill-switch contract: #3039
- Prior authz UAT Shell residual class: #3206, #3213, #3245, #3288, #3311, #3336, #3354, #3382, #3421, #3459, #3529

## Labels / routing

Security / agent-safety / tooling — framework-source fix in `packages/core/src/authz/`.
